reference_sql:
SELECT p.category_id,
       s.category_name,
       SUM(s.units) AS units,
       SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur,
       SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) / SUM(s.units) AS asp_eur
FROM sales AS s
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY p.category_id, s.category_name
ORDER BY p.category_id
alternatives:
SELECT p.category_id,
       c.category_name,
       SUM(ol.quantity) AS units,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) / SUM(ol.quantity) AS asp_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts))) = DATE '2025-03-01'
GROUP BY p.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY p.category_id

SELECT p.category_id,

       SUM(s.units) AS units,

FROM sales AS s
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-28 23:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-31 22:00:00'
GROUP BY p.category_id, s.category_name
ORDER BY p.category_id

solver.query:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name,
       SUM(ol.quantity) AS units,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) / SUM(ol.quantity) AS asp_eur
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = pr.category_id
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
HAVING SUM(ol.quantity) >= 1
ORDER BY c.category_id
